name: medmap
description: MedMap: a visual medication interaction map. Information tool, not medical advice.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @medmap/api && npm run build -w @medmap/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "tsc -b packages/shared/tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w @medmap/api" "npm run dev -w @medmap/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:shared && npm run test:coverage --workspaces
scripts.openapi: npm run build:shared && npm run openapi -w @medmap/api
scripts.openapi:check: npm run build:shared && npm run openapi -w @medmap/api -- --check
scripts.seed:demo: npm run build:shared && npm run seed:demo -w @medmap/api
scripts.migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run migrate -w @medmap/api
scripts.import:interactions: npm run build:shared && npm run import:interactions -w @medmap/api --
scripts.eval:extractor: npm run build:shared && npm run eval:extractor -w @medmap/api --
scripts.docs:check: npm run docs:lint && npm run docs:links && npm run docs:env
scripts.check:dataset: npm run build:shared && npm run check:dataset -w @medmap/api
scripts.check:rxnorm: npm run build:shared && npm run check:rxnorm -w @medmap/api
